idea: Push cross-engine plugin-path resolution UPSTREAM into the ralph-overview plugin's overview-init skill so every consumer gets working pnpm sync-ralph-state + pnpm overview under BOTH Claude Code AND Copilot CLI, without each consumer hand-rolling a per-repo resolver wrapper.

candidateDirections.name: Generated consumer wrapper (template-sourced) + wrapper-backed scripts, emitted atomically
candidateDirections.summary: overview-init copies a single tested self-contained resolver template to the consumer (bin/ default) and points the 4 package scripts at it in one atomic operation; fixes the semver-sort + node_modules-liveness bugs and adds a config hook for codexu-specific deltas.

candidateDirections.name: Init-time absolute dispatcher-path scripts (no wrapper) + repair command
candidateDirections.summary: overview-init resolves the current engine install once and writes absolute-path package scripts plus an overview-repair command; smallest surface but non-portable for committed/shared package.json and stales on Claude cache upgrades.

candidateDirections.name: Plugin-owned npm/bin shim or engine-neutral launcher (published shim package)
candidateDirections.summary: Ship one tested resolver as a versioned npm/bin shim; scripts call a stable command. Cleanest long-term but adds a package-distribution + auth + version-drift axis disproportionate to the current need.

questionsForSynthesis: Default wrapper location: bin/ralph-overview.mjs (continuity with codexu) vs scripts/ralph-overview.mjs (avoids common /bin gitignore)?
Liveness semantics: confirm manifest+dispatcher (NOT node_modules/chokidar) and the exact 'installed but dependencies missing' diagnostic + exit code.

Config schema for codexu-specific deltas: additionalProbePaths + localDevPluginRootRel for the submodule fallback, and a generic hook for the cli derive-next-command --snapshot default — or does codexu keep a thin shim?
API coupling: does the existing addPackageJsonScripts flag's meaning change to atomically include the wrapper, or is there a new single coupled flag, and what is the back-compat story?
Marketplace/plugin-name handling in the template: templated at emit time vs a constant block the template reads.
Architecture invariant #4 doc update wording (consumer wrapper as part of the generated consumer boundary).
